text:
Maya (product): Heads-up: Acme Health private beta ask. Requirements: 2048-dim embeddings, nightly bulk ingest ~800 qps, lookup P95 <60ms, and regional residency. Need quick scope: SLA, response shape, fallback policy.

Evan (eng-platform): Big tradeoffs: batch ceiling vs lookup latency. Propose two paths: lookup (max_batch=16) and ingest (chunk=512-1024). Per-tenant qps cap + burst (800/1500).

Priya (eng-ml): Model options: rwd-embed-2048 (float), rwd-embed-2048-q4 (quant), rwd-embed-1024. Recommend 2048-q4 default for beta; will run recall tests on Acme eval.

Leo (devex): Response metadata must be structured for their vector DB. Suggest default opt-in meta block with model_version, dims, request_id, fallback, compat_score.

Mina (sdk): Example response (opt-in meta):
{
  "vector": [0.12, -0.03, ...],
  "meta": {"model_version":"rwd-embed-2048-q4","dims":"2048","request_id":"req_...","fallback":"none","compat_score":"0.98","billing_units":"2.1"}
}

Omar (security): Residency: ingest jobs must run in-customer region or in their VPC. Require KMS per-tenant and audit logs for beta. PHI redaction must be documented or DPA signed.

Evan (eng-platform): Fallback plan: route-to-1024 if queue_latency>500ms; emit X-Embed-Fallback header and meta.fallback. Set fallback_rate alert >5%. KV cache to prioritize hot lookups.

Priya (eng-ml): Test matrix: recall@10 across 2048-full, 2048-q4, 1024; latency perf at 100/400/800 qps; memory pressure with KV cache. Publish results in 3 business days.

Maya (product): Proposed beta acceptance criteria: recall loss <=4% vs 2048-full; lookup P95<=60ms under expected mix; ingest sustains 800 qps for 30m; obs: dashboard (latency, fallback_rate, ingest_rate); signed DPA or redaction plan.

Mina (sdk): SDK flags: include_meta (opt-in), preferred_dims=[2048,1024], allow_fallback (default true). Backcompat: include_meta=false -> vector array only.

Maya (product): Action items:
- Priya: run evals (3 business days)
- Evan: perf + memory sizing (EOW)
- Mina: SDK PR + examples (+4 days)
- Omar: DPA checklist + KMS steps (+2 days)
- Leo: beta onboarding doc (+5 days)

deploy-bot: Branch detected `emb/acme-beta` 4 CI perf-harness queued.

Evan (eng-platform): I'll post perf numbers here after the run. If quant looks good we default to 2048-q4 for beta.
